svg.title: How the inventions connect
svg.desc: Six stages from left to right: Observation, asking what is actually there?, with CIRCLE, Luca, Qubit Noise; Interpretation, asking what might it mean?, with DNA Music, R.A.I.N. Lab, DRR; Decision, asking is the evidence enough to act?, with TRIAD, James, Pordenone; Action, asking what does the system do?, with Pine Gap, GHOSTWHEEL, Nocturne; Measurement, asking what happened, and how sure are we?, with Qubit Noise, Ascent, IONS-X; Verification, asking would it hold up again?, with rain-pipeline, Mannahatta, Project 33. From Decision, a dashed branch leads down to a box: Not enough evidence? Abstain, wait, or hand the decision to a person. TRIAD abstains, James asks, GHOSTWHEEL refuses. A line returns from Verification to Observation: what was learned changes what we look for next. The projects are separate systems placed where they do their main work; they are not one integrated architecture.
